common.searchTenders: Search tenders by title or number…
common.principle: The Rule Engine Decides. AI Only Explains.
common.decisionSupport: Decision support system. Final authority remains with the Procurement Officer.

auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.twofactorNote: Two-factor sign-in: after your password, a one-time code is sent by SMS to the mobile number registered on this account (your own number - never the owner's).
auth.otpExpiry: The code expires in 5 minutes and can be used 5 times. Never share it.
auth.trustDevice: Trust this device for 30 days (skip OTP on it)
auth.govLoginNote: Login uses your Government ID only - an OTP is sent to the phone registered against it. Email & password are not used.
auth.govOtpNote: The OTP is sent to the mobile number registered against this Government ID in the System-Admin employee master.
auth.govPending: Your account is awaiting System-Admin approval.
auth.govPendingHint: The OTP was sent to your registered phone, but this Government ID has not been approved by the System Admin yet. Contact the System Admin (GOV-0001); approval takes seconds and you can then retry.
auth.govApprovalNote: Officer accounts are managed by the System Admin (employee master: Government ID, registered phone, role). First login requires admin approval - email/password is not used on this portal.

bidder.consentDesc: To verify your compliance, GeM-Sentinel may retrieve and cross-verify records from the sources below. You can grant or revoke consent per source at any time. No protected information is fetched before consent.
bidder.consentDoneApply: Consent granted. You can now go back to the tender and submit your application.
bidder.alreadyAppliedTitle: You have already applied for this tender
bidder.existingApplicationNote: Application {no} - status: {status}. Track progress on My Applications.
bidder.consentVerified: Consent verified - granted on the Consent page
bidder.procuringOrgDesc: Publishing organization, its procurement division, and the delegated award authority for this tender's value.
bidder.corrigendaDesc: A compliance result based on the original document can become invalid after an amendment - verification always runs against the latest rule version.
bidder.twoLayerDesc: Two compliance layers: general statutory & GeM compliance, then tender-specific technical & safety compliance.
bidder.layerSector: Layer 2 - Tender-specific technical & safety compliance (petroleum sector)
bidder.applySnapshot: Your verified vault documents are attached automatically and reused (Verify Once, Apply Many).
bidder.snapshotFrozen: Documents are frozen as a bid-time snapshot at submission - later additions only via clarification.
bidder.vaultDesc: Verify once. Apply many. Government-verified documents are reused across applications.
bidder.applyBlockDesc: A confirmed mandatory requirement has failed. You cannot apply for this tender.
bidder.applyAllowDesc: You may apply. Unverified items will be reviewed manually.
bidder.declarationLabel: I declare that the information furnished in this application and the documents provided are true, complete and accurate to the best of my knowledge.
bidder.consentConfirm: I confirm that I have granted consent for compliance verification (see Consent page).
bidder.applicationSubmitted: Application submitted and routed for review
bidder.withdrawConfirm: Are you sure you want to withdraw this application?
bidder.applySubmittedId: Application submitted successfully. Application ID: {id} - track it end-to-end under your Applications.

complianceHealth.title: My Compliance Health
complianceHealth.subtitle: Your verified identifiers and registrations at a glance - fix lapsed or expiring items before they cost you a bid.
complianceHealth.watchInactive: Not active - starts when a verification runs

bidder.submissionCertHint: Official record that this bid was successfully submitted and registered.

officer.rerunHint: Re-run when documents update, clarification received, source refreshed, rules changed, or previous report expired.
officer.authenticityHint: AI may detect, extract, compare and explain - visual similarity of a seal or signature alone is never conclusive.
officer.staleCorrigendumTitle: Report is stale - a corrigendum was published after this run
officer.staleCorrigendumDesc: The results below were computed against an earlier rule version. The tender's conditions have since been amended.
officer.rerunToRefresh: Re-run AI verification to re-verify against the amended conditions.
officer.complianceMatrixDesc: Grouped by compliance layer - general statutory & GeM compliance, then tender-specific technical & safety compliance.
officer.boundaryNote: System recommends a review status only - it does not declare the outcome or award the tender. The procurement decision rests with the Tender Committee and the Competent Financial Authority.
officer.overrideWarning: You are attempting to proceed despite a blocking system finding. This action is fully recorded and may be referred to the external Vigilance authority for independent investigation.
officer.justificationHint: A meaningful justification is required (min {n} characters). Blank or trivial justifications are rejected.
officer.noReportYet: No verification report yet. Run AI verification to generate the full evidence-backed report.
officer.sourceFailNote: Source failure is recorded as UNABLE_TO_VERIFY - never as PASS.
officer.xaiDesc: A structured, auditable breakdown of the deterministic decision. The AI explains; it never decides.
officer.sealedNote: Before the bid deadline, bidder identities, bid content and verification results are hidden from all evaluation roles. Admin may force-open with a full audit trail.
officer.processFlowHint: 11 stages - each is acted by one officer role and produces a downloadable certificate of completion.
officer.docScopeBanner: {count} document types hidden - not required for your role
officer.docScopeText: Only documents relevant to your role are shown here. Other documents stay available to the stages that need them and remain in the audit record.
officer.roleMismatchText: This stage is acted by the {role}. You can view progress, but only that role (or Admin) can act.
officer.complianceHint: Run AI Verification first (Report tab) - this stage records its outcome.
officer.stageCertNote: Completing issues a numbered certificate (PDF) and appends a hash-chained audit record.
officer.certificatesHint: Downloadable evidence of every completed stage.
officer.remarksHint: Required - becomes part of the audited record.
officer.pipelineDoneText: All 11 stages completed. Download the stage certificates for the record.
officer.officerSummaryHint: The essentials first; full detail is in the sections below.
officer.pipelineProgressHint: The application moves forward stage by stage - each stage is acted by its assigned officer.
officer.pipelinePanelNote: Only the assigned officer of the current stage (or the System Admin) can complete it. Completing a stage issues a downloadable certificate and notifies the next owner.

admin.ruleHint: Rules are evaluated deterministically. Blacklist/debarment is always a hard compliance rule and cannot be removed.
admin.orgsDesc: Petroleum-sector procuring entities that publish tenders on the platform. Each organization carries its own procurement division and a value-driven authority chain (review role → approval role, with Tender Committee where delegated). Award authority is configured per organization and tender value - no fixed hierarchy.
admin.orgFormHint: Saving upserts by short code. Authority bands are JSON: value band (INR), review role title, approval role title, committee flag.
admin.corrigendaDesc: Publish an amendment to a published tender. If it affects eligibility/technical rules, the tender's rule version is bumped and earlier verification reports are marked stale for re-verification.
admin.noCorrigenda: No corrigenda published for this tender yet.
admin.blacklistTitle: Reference Blacklist Database - Source and Last Verification Date Recorded
admin.blacklistHint: Internal reference data. Not an official universal government blacklist. Entries cannot be hard-deleted - use status transitions.
admin.chainBroken: HASH CHAIN BROKEN - historical modification detected
admin.referralHint: Vigilance is an external escalation authority, not a platform role. Referrals are prepared for manual filing (CVC) - no automatic submission.
admin.collusionDesc: Cross-bidder comparison of bidder attributes & bid amounts. No human decision is made by this analysis.
admin.collusionEmpty: Run the analysis to inspect inter-bidder indicators for this tender.
admin.collusionClean: No shared-attribute indicators found among the bidders.
admin.collusionExcluded: Excluded common signals (too common to be meaningful)
admin.forceOpenConfirm: Force-open bids for this tender? This is audited and irreversible (confidentiality policy override by Admin).
admin.govEmployeesDesc: Employee master: Government ID, registered phone, role. Officers can log in only if present here; first login needs approval.
admin.employeeCreated: Employee created - status PENDING_APPROVAL. Approve it to enable login.
admin.phoneHelp: OTP destination. Format +91XXXXXXXXXX. This is where all OTPs for this ID will go.

risks.CRITICAL: Critical - Blacklisted/Debarred or Confirmed Mandatory Failure

landing.heroSub: Integrated bid compliance verification for GeM procurement. Deterministic rules decide; the model only explains.
landing.card1Text: PASS / FAIL / UNABLE_TO_VERIFY decided by configurable rules with full evidence traceability. Source failure never becomes PASS.
landing.card2Text: Every override requires re-authentication, meaningful justification, audit hashing, Admin notification and - for critical cases - Admin co-sign and external Vigilance referral.
landing.card3Text: Consent-gated, source-verified documents (Udyam, GST, PAN, MCA21, EPFO…) reused across tenders. Verify once, apply many.

docViewer.desc: Rendered by the Document Studio from the verified source data, with a SHA-256 content hash for integrity.

watch.title: Sentinel Watch - Watch Tower
watch.subtitle: Continuous compliance monitoring - value-level changes at verified sources are detected, classified and alerted.
watch.gateChecked: Gate check complete (blocking CRITICAL drifts are audited)
watch.simulated: GST flipped to CANCELLED for this bidder - one watch pass ran.
watch.restored: GST restored to its original value - one watch pass ran.
watch.noWatches: No active watches - watches are registered automatically when a verification completes.
watch.noPollsYet: No source polls recorded yet (watches register after verification).
watch.noSnoozeCritical: A CRITICAL drift can never be snoozed - acknowledge or escalate it.
